description: The state of an x402 conditional payment by its terms hash (the x402 payment identifier): pending (no money yet), settled (the money is at the address), duplicate_swept (a second settle landed and went back to the buyer), disputed, released (paid to the seller) or returned (back to the buyer), with the window end and expiry. Retrying a settle with the same terms lands at the same address, so this tells failed from landed late. Read only.
name: ifso_release_status
title: x402 conditional payment status
